description: Find remote MCP servers listed in the Official MCP Registry, with MCP Station's daily measurements. Turn the user's need into words (q) plus filters. Example: 'crypto market data, no API key, working' -> q='crypto market data', auth='none', reachable=true. Results are ordered by relevance first, then by published rank rules (measurements only, no paid placement). similar_to='<registry name>' returns other working servers in the same categories with the same authentication.

reachable.description: true = answered at the last check

risk.description: Declared by the server's tool hints

similar_to.description: Registry name of a server to find alternatives for

name: search_servers
title: Search remote MCP servers
